title: Getting Started with AWS
summary: What AWS is, how the SAA-C03 exam is built, and the global infrastructure every later lesson relies on: Regions, Availability Zones, edge points of presence, and extensions such as Local Zones, Wavelength and Outposts. Covers how to choose a Region, AZ names versus AZ IDs, which services are global and which are Regional, the IaaS/PaaS/FaaS/SaaS models, and a first tour of the AWS Management Console and CloudShell.
